internal_review.initial_attempt: Repository commands rejected by execution policy; no inspection in that attempt.
internal_review.fallback: Same read-only policy; supplied source and diff as text. Review completed without tools.
internal_review.finding: Deleted fixture name reuse duplicates group membership; fixed with regression.

fixed_findings.issue: Native pattern backtracking bypassed instruction budget.
fixed_findings.resolution: Remove native pattern functions; subprocess watchdog regressions.

fixed_findings.issue: Additional emitter defaults could light fixtures during blackout.
fixed_findings.resolution: Explicit dark semantics for additive/subtractive emitters, including idle and script faults.

fixed_findings.issue: Source silence cut lighting before buffered audio ended and discarded queued intents.
fixed_findings.resolution: Retain audible-tail commands; schedule confirmed stop at delayed source boundary.

fixed_findings.issue: Unwritable health file stopped media playback.
fixed_findings.resolution: Nonfatal writes with throttled logging and bidirectional-heartbeat regression.

fixed_findings.issue: Final fixture encoding errors terminated rendering.
fixed_findings.resolution: Publish safe darkness, retain diagnostics and allow recovery.

fixed_findings.issue: Accepted white-only GDTF fixture rendered dark.
fixed_findings.resolution: Independent white-emitter mapping with intensity regressions.

fixed_findings.issue: Folded BPM and raw detector beat positions used inconsistent units.
fixed_findings.resolution: Transmit detector tempo alongside detector beat positions; retain folded analysis/display BPM.

fixed_findings.issue: Cache identity omitted decoder and model changes and untracked source contents.
fixed_findings.resolution: Hash runtime dependency and active artifact contents.

fixed_findings.issue: Deleting a fixture and reusing its name duplicated group membership.
fixed_findings.resolution: Restore prior order only for surviving original rows; regression added.

fixed_findings.issue: Shared training CLI default ignored RAVEFORM_DATA_DIR.
fixed_findings.resolution: Use corpus_dir resolver; environment override regression.

fixed_findings.issue: Dashboard profiler referenced a removed helper.
fixed_findings.resolution: Profile current command diagnostics; CPU-only smoke passed.

fixed_findings.issue: Custom corpus readiness and report identity could describe different model artifacts than the actual simulation.
fixed_findings.resolution: Thread the selected corpus through inference, extractor/tracker cache planning, model reuse and report fingerprints.

fixed_findings.issue: Trainer target, class-weight and downbeat-grid paths used published-only labels despite merged-label dataset admission.
fixed_findings.resolution: Apply user-approved manual corrections to admitted tracks through the shared merged loader, retaining split and evaluation exclusions.

naming_review.reason: Fresh isolated reader spawn was rejected by the session agent-thread limit. Independent implementation review completed; not claimed as a blind naming pass.

python_full_suite.resolution: Failure audited against fresh full ten-track reports; all gates pass after the three expected retained-tail checksum updates. Full suite was not redundantly repeated.

backtest.baseline_update: Three checksum expectations and pipeline identity updated after exact retained-tail parity audit. Scores, counts and tolerances unchanged.

validation.physical_output: Not exercised in this review; last live startup audition was confirmed by user before this task.
validation.fixture_and_gdtf_tests: Passed in broad suite, including group-name reuse regression

user_decisions: Manual corrections override published annotations for already admitted training tracks; evaluation holdouts remain excluded.

behavior: Grid is the primary patch editor; click opens fixture details.
Drag preserves the grabbed channel offset and validates the complete fixture footprint.
Overlaps, invalid addresses and stale moves leave the draft unchanged.
Universe selector sits beside the grid heading; manufacturer controls and patch table are removed.

validation.browser: Real Edge pointer events on a copied rig: row wrapping, offset, collision, bounds, Escape/outside cancellation, details, save/reload and group order.
validation.asset_packaging: JavaScript verified byte-for-byte in wheel and source distribution.
validation.independent_review: Pointer/callback/persistence review complete; click suppression now expires after the pointer release.

naming.implementation: autolux/lighting/fixture_setup.py:repatch_dmx_fixture returns a validated draft after changing one identified fixture’s Art-Net universe and DMX start address; no persistence or hardware output.

attempts.reader: /root/blind_repatch_fixture; fresh names-only context, low effort, no tools
attempts.prediction: Together, these suggest reassigning a fixture identified by fixture_id to an address range beginning at start_address within universe. They do not reveal whether the operation also changes physical connections, reserves a range, or checks collisions.
attempts.comparison: Core address reassignment aligned; domain was ambiguous. Renamed function and address inputs to name DMX/Art-Net explicitly.

attempts.reader: /root/blind_repatch_dmx_fixture; fresh names-only context, low effort, no tools
attempts.prediction: Together, these suggest changing a fixture’s destination group and starting address, but the names alone do not establish validation rules, side effects, or whether the operation persists changes.
attempts.comparison: Address reassignment aligned. Protocol terms retained; indexing, validation and absence of persistence are explicit in the boundary docstring/tests, not inferred from names.

naming.disposition: Address-move meaning aligned; names-only inference of validation/side effects remains limited. DMX and Art-Net numbering follow documented protocol conventions.
